headline: TIGER GOLD OPENS 465-METRE GOLD SYSTEM FROM SURFACE — 165.7M AT 0.9 G/T HITS AT DEPTH IN COLOMBIA'S MID-CAUCA
snippet: Tiger Gold Corp reported results from two drillholes at its Ceibal target at the Quinchía Gold Project in Colombia's Mid-Cauca belt on September 15 — CEDDH-018 intersected 465 metres at 0.6 g/t Au and 1.0 g/t Ag from surface, while CEDDH-019 confirmed a distinct deep zone at 165.7 metres at 0.9 g/t Au from 284 metres downhole, ending in mineralization. The results confirm a large, continuous gold system open in multiple directions, with a maiden mineral resource estimate targeted for Q1 2027 as part of an ongoing 20,000-metre drill campaign.

headline: GDXJ CRATERS 4% AS GOLD HITS FIVE-WEEK LOW AT $4,263 — BOND YIELDS RACE TOWARD 5% AHEAD OF WEDNESDAY'S FOMC
snippet: Gold fell to a five-week low of $4,263 per ounce on September 15 while the VanEck Junior Gold Miners ETF (GDXJ) dropped over 4% and sits roughly 10% below its late-August high, as the 10-year Treasury yield approached 5% and futures markets priced a 92% probability of a 25-basis-point Fed rate hike on Wednesday. The sell-off is the third consecutive day of gold losses and the longest losing streak since early July — junior miners falling four times harder than bullion itself as investors cut leveraged equity exposure ahead of the decision.

headline: SHAREHOLDERS SAY YES — CENTRAL ASIA METALS' A$232M CYGNUS DEAL CLEARS THE LAST GATE FOR CHIBOUGAMAU COPPER-GOLD
snippet: Central Asia Metals shareholders approved on September 15 the resolution authorizing directors to allot new shares needed to complete the all-share acquisition of Cygnus Metals, valued at approximately A$232 million. The deal adds Chibougamau, a brownfield copper-gold project in Quebec with a 6.4 million tonne M&I resource at approximately 3% copper equivalent across 18 kilometres of strike, to CAML's existing Kounrad (Kazakhstan) and Sasa (North Macedonia) producing portfolio — completing a transition from single-jurisdiction copper miner to a multi-asset critical metals group.

headline: SILVER GOES 24/7 — $15M TRADES IN CME'S DEBUT WEEKEND AS RETAIL APPETITE FOR ALWAYS-ON METALS ACCESS CONFIRMED
snippet: CME Group reported September 14 that 2,387 contracts representing over $15 million in notional value traded during the inaugural weekend of its 100-ounce silver futures contract, which launched September 11 as part of CME's 24/7 trading expansion. The launch follows CME's July 24 debut of 24/7 one-ounce gold futures, which drew over $600 million in weekend notional volume across its first seven weeks — establishing retail demand for around-the-clock precious metals access and setting a new structural milestone for silver market liquidity.

headline: THE STRANGE SELLOFF: WHY MONEY METALS SAYS GOLD IS FALLING EVEN AFTER 92% OF TRADERS PRICED IN THE HIKE
snippet: Money Metals Exchange's September 14 analysis unpacks the paradox of gold continuing to fall despite a Fed rate hike already priced at 92% certainty — arguing the sell-off is less about the upcoming decision and more about bond vigilantes repricing the longer end of the yield curve, with 10-year Treasury yields approaching 5%. The piece identifies this correction as technically-driven rather than fundamental, and argues that historical precedent from prior Fed tightening cycles shows gold typically resolves sharply higher within four to six weeks once the rate picture clarifies.

headline: GOLDSEEK: GOLD CLEARED $4,300 — THE CASE FOR $4,500, WHERE THE SHORT-TERM RISKS HIDE, AND SILVER'S OVERVALUATION SIGNAL
snippet: GoldSeek's mid-September Gold SWOT analysis identifies gold's clearing of the $4,300 level as a technically significant development, with $4,500 now the next major resistance threshold if the FOMC outcome resolves bearish sentiment. Weaknesses include silver's apparent short-term overvaluation after its 14% August outperformance of gold — a setup that historically precedes a reversion to the mean — while the structural strengths of central bank buying, institutional ETF inflows (North American gold-backed funds added 53.3 tonnes in Q3), and AI data centre power demand remain intact.

headline: BOND VIGILANTES SMELL BLOOD — MONEY METALS ON WHY MINERS FELL 4X HARDER THAN GOLD ON AUGUST'S PAYROLLS SHOCK
snippet: Money Metals Exchange's September 14 analysis of the bond market selloff argues that Treasury Secretary Bessent's refusal to back down from bond vigilantes has created an unusual dynamic where 10-year yields approaching 5% are simultaneously pressuring gold short-term and validating its long-term safe-haven case. The piece explains the key metric retail investors misread: why gold miners fell four times harder than bullion itself on August's payrolls shock — a miner beta amplification that is misinterpreted as sector weakness rather than institutionally-driven equity deleveraging.

headline: THREE FOMC SCENARIOS FOR GOLD AT $4,263 — GOLDSILVER'S PRE-DECISION PLAYBOOK FOR RETAIL INVESTORS
snippet: GoldSilver's September 2026 preview of the Fed's September 15-16 meeting maps three scenarios — a 25bps hike with neutral forward guidance, a hike with hawkish November signalling, or a surprise hold — and models the likely gold and silver price response to each. With the market already pricing 92% hike odds, the analysis argues the biggest risk is not the hike itself but any signal about November, and that silver's speculative positioning at $62.99 remains asymmetrically set up for a rebound on any dovish surprise given the ongoing structural supply deficit.

headline: COLOMBIA PORPHYRY DEBUT: OROSUR HITS 61M AT 0.93 G/T AU FROM SURFACE IN FIRST-EVER DRILL AT EL CEDRO
snippet: Orosur Mining announced encouraging initial results from its El Cedro prospect within the Anzá Project in Colombia's Mid-Cauca gold belt, with first-ever drill hole CED001 returning 61.35 metres at 0.93 g/t Au including 42.15 metres at 1.02 g/t Au from surface, prior to entering the anticipated vein system at approximately 100 metres depth. Assays are pending for the deeper portion of the 500-metre planned hole, where surface channel samples grading up to 8.83 g/t Au and increasing vein density at depth suggest grades could improve substantially — pointing to a potentially significant porphyry-hydrothermal system.

headline: MAIDEN DRILL HITS WALKER LANE — SIENNA RESOURCES TARGETS NEVADA'S RICHEST GOLD CORRIDOR AT ESMERALDA COUNTY
snippet: Sienna Resources (TSX-V: SIEN) announced September 15 that Titan Drilling has mobilized to site and commenced the company's maiden drill program at its Esmeralda County Gold Project, located within Nevada's Walker Lane trend — one of North America's most prolific gold-producing corridors and host to the Round Mountain, Bald Mountain, and Coeur Rochester mines. The maiden program tests multiple gold targets identified by prior sampling programs, with the company reporting a strong cash position to support additional work programs through H2 2026.
